# Eraya Experience

> Eraya Experience (Eraya Experience LLP) is a creative and digital marketing agency based in Porvorim, Goa, India, working with brands across India and worldwide. It offers graphic and logo design, photoshoots, social media marketing, Meta and Google ads, influencer marketing, brand kits, and websites with SEO, all under one roof and measured by real, trackable growth.

- Website: https://erayaexperience.com
- Founded and led by Alizah Alam (Founder) and Siddharth Gopal (Co-Founder)
- Based in Porvorim, Goa, India; serves clients across India and worldwide, with all work delivered remotely
- 6+ years of experience, 30+ brands grown, 10+ creative minds
- Contact: info.erayaexp@gmail.com, +91 8208664702, Instagram @erayaexperience, LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/eraya-experience-marketing

## Services

- Graphic & Logo Design: Logos, posters and campaign graphics with a point of view, recognised in a second and remembered long after.
- Photoshoots: Food, drinks, fashion and lifestyle shoots, styled and lit so the product is the hero of every frame.
- Social Media Marketing: Pages planned around the audience and the brand's goals. Consistent, aesthetic and always on brand.
- Meta & Google Ads: Ads built around one number, return. Every rupee tracked, every campaign sharpened.
- Influencer Marketing: The right creators for the brand, matched to the audience so people talk, share and show up.
- Brand Kits: Logo, colours, type and branded essentials in one complete kit.
- Website & SEO: Fast, beautiful websites built to rank on Google and turn visitors into customers.

## Selected results

- Mission Rabies (national NGO, social media marketing): repositioned the page with a quirky, fun and informative voice; 912.5K total reach, 11,666 engagements, 727 new followers.
- Snow Park Goa (entertainment venue): 20% lift in walk-ins and 50M+ campaign reach.
- Beach Walk Resort (luxury resort, paid campaigns): 80,404 views generated; external taps up 1,900%.
- Sukkha (restaurant, Goa): monsoon off-season hiring ads brought 17+ enquiries in one day.
- Get Secured (insurance): complete brand kit and logo delivered in 3 days.
- Fashion label: went from zero sales in the three months before to 189 sales in its first month with Eraya.

## Clients

Over 30 brands across food and beverage, hospitality, wellness, fashion, finance, construction and non-profits, including Sukkha, Carlito's by the Sea, Lilliput, Koleso 24/7 Lounge Bar, Istorea by the Sea, Snow Park Goa, Thunder World Goa, Mission Rabies, Garudadhwaj Foundation, Get Secured, The Adhisha, House of Yogis, The A-Frame Builders and Nutradried.

## Frequently asked questions

- Where is Eraya Experience based? Porvorim, Goa, India. It works with brands across India and worldwide.
- What kinds of brands does Eraya work with? Food and beverage, hospitality, wellness, fashion, finance, construction and non-profits.
- How does Eraya measure results? Every campaign is tied to a tracked number: reach, engagement, enquiries, footfall or sales.
- How fast can Eraya deliver a brand kit? It depends on scope; Get Secured's complete brand kit was delivered in 3 days.
- How do I start a project? Use the enquiry form at https://erayaexperience.com/#contact, email info.erayaexp@gmail.com, call +91 8208664702, or message @erayaexperience on Instagram.
